### Meta-ecosystems (`ds_metaecosystems`)

-   Each row is a meta-ecosystem.

```{r}
ds_metaecosystems <- list()
row_i = 0
system_nrs = unique(combinations_isolated_n_metaecos$system_nr)

for (system_i in system_nrs) {
  for (time_point_i in time_points) {
    row_i = row_i + 1
    
    culture_IDs_of_system_i = c(
      combinations_isolated_n_metaecos %>% filter(system_nr == system_i) %>% pull(ID_green_patch),
      combinations_isolated_n_metaecos %>% filter(system_nr == system_i) %>% pull(ID_blue_patch)
    )
    
    ds_metaecosystems[[row_i]] = ds_patches %>%
      filter(culture_ID %in% culture_IDs_of_system_i,
             time_point == time_point_i) %>%
      summarise(total_metaecosystem_bioarea_mm2 = sum(bioarea_tot_mm2),
                patch_size_ml = mean(patch_size_ml)) %>%
      mutate(
        system_nr = system_i,
        patches_combined = combinations_isolated_n_metaecos %>% filter(system_nr == system_i) %>% pull(patches_combined),
        system_type = combinations_isolated_n_metaecos %>% filter(system_nr == system_i) %>% pull(system_type),
        time_point = time_point_i,
        day = sampling_days[time_point_i + 1]
      ) %>%
      ungroup()
    
  }
}

ds_metaecosystems = ds_metaecosystems %>%
  bind_rows() %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  select(
    time_point,
    day,
    system_nr,
    system_type,
    patch_size_ml,
    patches_combined,
    total_metaecosystem_bioarea_mm2
  ) %>%
  filter(!system_nr %in% metaecosystems_to_take_off)
```

```{r}

# Reorder levels

ds_metaecosystems = ds_metaecosystems %>%
  mutate(system_type = factor(system_type,
                             levels = metaecosystem_types_ordered))
```
